newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK to boost land supply 46 pct by 2001 - Tsang.
newsitem.headline: HK to boost land supply 46 pct by 2001 - Tsang.

text.p: The Hong Kong government plans to release 46 percent more land for residential development over the next five years, Financial Secretary Donald Tsang said on Wednesday.

"In the last five years, the government had made available 257 hectares of land for public rental and subsidised home ownership flats, and another 145 hectares for private development," Tsang said in his 1997/98 budget speech.
"Over the next five years we plan to release another 327 hectares for public and 260 hectares for private housing, an increase of 46 percent over the past five years."
He said he also planned to chair a special task force to look at land supply and its impact on infrastructure and housing development.
